episode_title: Caspar x Linhardt B - Tall Opponent Tactics
source_summary: Caspar cannot beat taller opponents, begs Linhardt for a strategy, learns a defensive counterplan, then drags Linhardt into exhausting practice until Linhardt escapes.

characters.name: Caspar
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Caspar: youthful compact build, short pale-blue tousled hair, direct earnest face, Black Eagles black academy uniform with red cape and house sleeve patch; urgent body language but controlled mouth and eyes, never a mature bulky strongman.

characters.name: Linhardt
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Linhardt: sleepy green medium-length hair, soft intelligent face, slender student build, Black Eagles academy uniform with collar, gold trim, red/black mantle detail, and book when visible; tired and dry, not gloomy, not in robes.

frame_intents.start: Caspar pulls Linhardt toward practice with a wooden training weapon ready.
frame_intents.key: Linhardt is exhausted, leaning on his knees while Caspar is still eager.
frame_intents.end: Linhardt slips away toward water while Caspar slowly realizes he escaped.

dialogue.speaker: Caspar
dialogue.text: 君が疎かにしがちな守りを、まずは鍛えなきゃね。

dialogue.speaker: Caspar
dialogue.text: そうか。じゃあ早速、付き合ってくれよ。

dialogue.speaker: Linhardt
dialogue.text: やれやれ……。はあ……適当なとこで逃げよ。

dialogue.speaker: Caspar
dialogue.text: さあ、もう一度だ、リンハルト！ 来い！

dialogue.speaker: Linhardt
dialogue.text: 水、取ってくる……じゃあね……。

dialogue.speaker: Caspar
dialogue.text: ……しまった！ あいつ、逃げやがったな！？

primary_check: Pay off Linhardt's laziness after Caspar turns advice into mandatory sparring.
frame_aspect_policy: clean 16:9 single-frame images; no contact-sheet crop, no synthetic border, no letterbox, no pillarbox, no blurred side fill
